state_source: Previous committed fused segment endpoint, detached. Merge retries reuse the prior stored for the matching start anchor.
decay: exp(-frame_offset / hierarchical_span) applied to logits; span stays 10 even in merged segments
evaluation: Frozen six-profile inference ablation, no training or test-label adaptation. Validation and test reported separately; 38-case test is the performance table. Public test is not a new blind holdout.
